skill-descriptions.check-agent-os: When you want to verify the Agent OS installation is healthy and up to date
skill-descriptions.close-sprint: When all sprint tracks are complete and you want to close the sprint, bump version, and archive
skill-descriptions.create-agent: When you want to scaffold a new agent file interactively
skill-descriptions.orchestrator: Loaded automatically at session start — defines triage logic and routing. Not user-invoked directly.
skill-descriptions.setup-connector: When the user runs /setup-connector <name> to apply a connector config and write MCP entries to settings.json
skill-descriptions.track-status: When you want a quick status summary of open sprint tracks
skill-descriptions.triage: Surfaces open GitHub issues and backlog candidates for sprint planning — read-only, never edits backlog.md
